_comment: ClarityAccount — Custom Object Definition for Module 7 (CRM Integration)
INTENDED DESIGN (storageType: proxy)
Create a Proxy Object that forwards all CRUD operations to an external CRM
endpoint, letting Liferay's Object Framework expose CRM data through a generated
REST API at /o/c/clarityaccounts/ without local storage.
FEATURE FLAG STATUS (verified 2026-07-02)
Feature flag 'Proxy Object (LPS-135430)' is ACTIVE in this workspace.
Last server restart: 2026-07-01 18:47 UTC (after flag was enabled).
The flag was set via Control Panel → System Settings (stored in DB).
PHASE 1 RESULT — storageType: 'proxy' ACCEPTED for object definition creation
POST /o/object-admin/v1.0/object-definitions with storageType: 'proxy'
→ HTTP 201, 'storageType': 'proxy' confirmed in response.
→ No more ObjectDefinitionStorageTypeException.
PHASE 2 RESULT — Proxy object RUNTIME is non-functional
After creating and publishing a proxy ClarityAccount object:
GET /o/c/clarityaccounts/ → HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
Root cause from log:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke
'ObjectEntryManager.getObjectEntries(...)' because 'objectEntryManager' is null
The ObjectEntryManager for the proxy storage type is not registered/available.
Additionally, 'proxyEndpointURL' is not accepted:
- As a top-level field → 'The property proxyEndpointURL is not defined'
- In objectDefinitionSettings → 'not allowed for object definition ClarityAccount'
Conclusion: The feature flag enables CREATING proxy object definitions, but the
runtime delegation layer (proxy ObjectEntryManager) is not implemented yet in
DXP 2026.Q1.2-LTS. The proxy URL cannot be configured via any API endpoint.
IMPLEMENTED ALTERNATIVE (used in course)
storageType: 'default' (local database storage) — fully functional.
Identical REST API surface: GET/POST /o/c/clarityaccounts/
Students import CRM data via the Headless Batch Engine.
Pedagogical outcome is identical: a custom object queryable from fragments.
BATCH IMPORT ALTERNATIVE (for live CRM data)
POST /o/headless-batch-engine/v1.0/import-task/com.liferay.object.rest.dto.v1_0.ObjectEntry
storageType: 'proxy' is now ACCEPTED by the API (feature flag active).
Object can be created and published — but GET /o/c/clarityaccounts/ returns 500.
objectEntryManager is null at runtime. proxyEndpointURL cannot be set via API.
Delete this object immediately after creation — it is not functional.
